gameplay_intent: Practice earns repeatable cultivation XP; memorable classic Monk deeds provide one-time XP bonuses; rank advancement is not hard-gated by classic ordeals. No Tyz/MXP involved.
tuning: Initial test profile; early ranks 1-4 preserved, ranks 5-20 accelerated from previous 28,000 max to 14,300 max. Review against live server logs and expected sessions before shipping.
economy: Monk custom XP, not vanilla XP or Tyz MXP; one native technique point per rank. Classic native abilities are auto-granted regardless of points.

safe_server_events: barehand_block_break: only on uncanceled BlockDropsEvent with player breaker, no equipped mainhand item and empty event tool; pre-commit BlockEvent.BreakEvent alone grants no XP.
unarmed_kill: only when credited player is the actual damage source's direct entity and has an empty main hand; arrows and spell projectiles are not treated as fist strikes.
kill: player-attributed source, restricted by a configurable curated hostile entity tag. Spell kills remain viable where owner attribution works.
food_discovered: one award per item registry ID, persisted across death/relog; item data variants do not refresh discovery.
advancement: one standard earned advancement signal, recipe unlock IDs explicitly ignored; other technical hidden advancements still require auditing.
animal_petted: only accepted server-owned Animal Friendship interactions; 20 distinct animal source semantics not yet enforced.
production_blockers: Player-placed block provenance and protected-block final success audit; early stone/obsidian milestone can be earned using player-placed blocks once, but repeatable XP should not reward cheap place-break farming.
HT TreeChop and modded magic completed blocks must signal every genuine player-credited block; mass break multicredit is not verified.
Modded mob taxonomy expansion beyond tag's vanilla pilot roster; don't reward passive farm mobs.
Past completed advancement migration, especially personally credited Dragon kill, for established world saves.
Original environmental/gaze/dodge/sprint/sleep/fall deeds are pending actual server detectors and are excluded from live milestones.
Source Animal pet-20 distinct UID requirement not enforced; one-time milestone cannot pay repeatedly but can count multiple breedings of same animal.
Wither deed currently uses credited death, not original >=25%-boss-health unarmored non-projectile contribution ledger.
Actual skill UI, progress toast, logged per-activity XP breakdown and multiplayer/claims smoke test.
